events.title: US Treasury Coordinated Yen Intervention (Joint with Japan)
events.summary: US Treasury conducted rare coordinated yen-buying intervention with Japan. First joint US-Japan FX intervention in modern history. $5-10bil deployed. South Korea also joined.

events.title: 2026 Iran War - Strait of Hormuz Crisis ACTIVE
events.summary: Active US-Israel war on Iran. Hormuz partially blocked. Tanker explosions Aug 5-6. Houthis attacking Saudi tankers. Brent spiked 10-13%. Qatar mediating.

events.title: Trilateral US-Japan-Korea Coordinated Currency Intervention
events.summary: Unprecedented joint FX intervention by US, Japan, South Korea to support yen and won. Won hit 9-month high. Carry trade risks persist.

events.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic - WHO PHEIC Active, 1800+ Deaths
events.summary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak DRC declared PHEIC May 16. 3,874 confirmed cases, 1,751 deaths DRC, 2 in Uganda. 717 hospitalized. Largest Bundibugyo outbreak ever.

events.title: Oil Supply Disruption - Hormuz + Houthi Red Sea Attacks
events.summary: Brent jumped 10-13% on Hormuz disruption. 20% global oil/LNG transits strait. Bab el-Mandeb traffic collapsed from 20 to 1 vessel. $100/bbl risk.

events.title: BOJ Holds at 1% Amid Yen Crisis and Intervention
events.summary: BOJ left rates at 1% (8-1, Takata dissented for 1.25%). Ueda warned of rapid hikes if inflation persists. Yen at 40-year lows triggered joint intervention.
